items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The real thing, Aunt Addie, and her son, Junior. Junior played organ and still does.

ctx.x: Have you had musical training before you picked up the vibraphone?

Well, that’s a good one. Yeah. My aunt, Aunt Addie, who lived in Watts, which – she was a minister of the Holy Roller Church. It was one of those churches. It was in a tent. They would really get to going, where everybody was screaming and hollering and shaking, and everybody’s rolling around on the ground? The Holy Ghost. You know what I’m saying? The real thing, Aunt Addie, and her son, Junior. Junior played organ and still does. Unbelievable organ player. He plays a lot down in Arizona until they burned his…
We may come back to that.
